briefs.label: Clear brief (journey 1)
briefs.text: Frontend engineers need to understand the required changes for one component-library release without searching across documents. Explore a static migration guide for Button and Input. It will use our changelog and migration documentation. Exclude automated code changes, application scanning, and analytics. The next step is a design brief, not implementation. We have not tested whether a consolidated guide saves time.

briefs.label: Ambiguous brief (journey 2)
briefs.text: Help independent restaurants deal with operational incidents. It should be easy to use and give owners visibility. I don't know whether we need new software or a better process.

briefs.label: Malformed reading, then success
briefs.text: Plan a weekend food drive with a volunteer group. The next step is a planning checklist.

replies.label: Detailed reply
replies.text: Coordination during service first. Explore shift managers as the primary user. Owner reporting is outside this discovery round. Leave the channel undecided; I want interviews before deciding whether to build software.

replies.label: Defer reply
replies.text: Keep both possibilities open; I need to understand current practices first.

texts.paraphrasedBrief: Small owner-run restaurants keep getting caught out when something goes wrong mid-shift: a fridge fails, a supplier doesn't show, someone calls in sick. We want handling these problems to be simpler, and owners should be able to see what happened. It's not clear to me yet whether this calls for an app or just a better way of working.
